website.note: Marketing-style asset pages for obicetrapib monotherapy and obicetrapib/ezetimibe FDC; root /pipeline returns 404

pipeline.modality: Small molecule, oral, low-dose, highly selective CETP inhibitor (10 mg once daily)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (originally Dezima Pharma; obicetrapib was previously TA-8995)

indications.indication: Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) and/or ASCVD with elevated LDL-C on max-tolerated lipid-lowering therapy (monotherapy)
indications.trial_name: BROADWAY (pivotal P3 monotherapy) and BROOKLYN (pivotal P3 in HeFH)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 of obicetrapib 10 mg as adjunct to maximally tolerated lipid-lowering therapy
indications.trial_status: BROADWAY/BROOKLYN both COMPLETED, met primary endpoints; EMA/UK/Switzerland MAAs accepted for review (Aug 2025) for monotherapy via Menarini partnership; US NDA planned

indications.indication: HeFH / ASCVD / ASCVD risk equivalents on max-tolerated therapy (FDC obicetrapib + ezetimibe)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 of 10 mg obicetrapib + 10 mg ezetimibe FDC vs placebo and component monotherapies
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED; topline data Nov 2024 (met primary and secondary endpoints, ~52% LDL-C reduction); EMA/UK/CH MAAs accepted for FDC; US NDA planned shortly after monotherapy NDA

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 CVOT in >9,500 ASCVD patients with elevated LDL-C; primary endpoint MACE (CV death, MI, stroke, coronary revascularization); minimum 2.5-year follow-up
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed Apr 2024; primary completion Nov 2026 — earliest readout end of 2026 pending event accrual)

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 CCTA imaging study in ~300 high-risk ASCVD patients of obicetrapib 10 mg + ezetimibe 10 mg FDC vs placebo
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (started 2024-05-16; enrollment expected to complete in 2026; primary completion 2027-11)

indications.indication: Type 2 diabetes and/or metabolic syndrome with elevated LDL-C on guideline-recommended lipid-lowering therapy
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled 12-week Phase 3 of obicetrapib 10 mg or obicetrapib/ezetimibe FDC vs placebo, with 9-month open-label extension; ~300 patients
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (started 2025-12-11; topline expected end of 2026; primary completion 2028-03)

indications.indication: Mild dyslipidemia — Lp(a) lowering with obicetrapib +/- evolocumab
indications.trial_design: Single-arm Phase 2 in two Lp(a) cohorts (n=39 high, n=30 mid); obicetrapib 10 mg x 8 wk then + evolocumab 140 mg Q2W x 8 wk

indications.indication: Antioxidant biomarker effects in healthy volunteers
indications.trial_design: Randomized placebo-controlled study of obicetrapib 10 mg effect on antioxidants in plasma and HDL particles

excluded_preclinical.reason: Earlier P2a (NCT05161715) completed in 2023; new clinical trial planned to initiate in 2026 — not yet active
Preclinical studies planned; T2DM endpoint embedded in PREVAIL CVOT only

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Active not recruiting; mechanistic / completed primary

excluded_legacy_terminated.trial: NCT06048302 / NCT06547359 / NCT06250205 / NCT06081166 / NCT06050291 (P1 PK / DDI / food-effect / hepatic-impairment)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Healthy-volunteer / mechanistic Phase 1 studies, all completed
